mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.profit), 0) AS profit, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS fees, COALESCE(SUM(o.cost_amount), 0) AS cost FROM ecom_order o WHERE

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.local_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN o.local_status IN ('EXCEPTION', 'ON_HOLD', 'OUT_OF_STOCK') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ship_by < #{now} AND o.local_status IN ('PENDING', 'ON_HOLD', 'EXCEPTION', 'OUT_OF_STOCK', 'AUDITED', 'LABELED', 'OUTBOUND', 'PARTIAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_inbound WHERE status = 'SHIPPED'

SELECT CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.profit), 0) AS profit FROM ecom_order o WHERE GROUP BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) ORDER BY day

SELECT o.store_id, s.name AS store_name, oi.seller_sku, MAX(oi.platform_item_id) AS platform_item_id, MAX(oi.title) AS title, MAX(m.code) AS material_code, MAX(m.name) AS material_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM(x.line_fc * o.exchange_rate) AS sales, SUM(x.share * ) AS fees, SUM(x.share * ) AS refund, SUM(COALESCE(oi.cost, 0)) AS cost, SUM(x.share * COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0)) AS shipping, SUM(x.line_fc * o.exchange_rate - x.share * ( + + COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0)) - COALESCE(oi.cost, 0)) AS profit FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = oi.material_id JOIN (SELECT oi2.id, (oi2.amount + COALESCE(oi2.shipping, 0) + COALESCE(oi2.tax, 0) - COALESCE(oi2.discount, 0)) AS line_fc, CASE WHEN o3.total_amount > 0 THEN (oi2.amount + COALESCE(oi2.shipping, 0) + COALESCE(oi2.tax, 0) - COALESCE(oi2.discount, 0)) / o3.total_amount ELSE 0 END AS share FROM ecom_order_item oi2 JOIN ecom_order o3 ON o3.id = oi2.order_id) x ON x.id = oi.id WHERE
AND (oi.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR oi.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY o.store_id, s.name, oi.seller_sku ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AS country, COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM ecom_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT o2.id FROM ecom_order o2 WHERE COALESCE(o2.ship_country, '') = COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') AND o2.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o2.order_time >= #{begin} AND o2.order_time < #{end} AND o2.store_id = #{storeId})), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.profit), 0) AS profit FROM ecom_order o WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(o.ship_country, '') ORDER BY sales DESC
